pr_title: Fix crash and empty action in SUI Actions Page
pr_body:
## Summary of the Pull Request
Fixes two issues related to SUI's Actions page:
1. Crash when adding an action and setting key chord to one that is already taken
   - **Cause**: the new key binding that was introduced with the "Add new" button appears in `_KeyBindingList` that we're iterating over. This has no `CurrentKeys()`, resulting in a null pointer exception.
   - **Fix**: null-check it
2. There's an action that appears as being nameless in the dropdown
   - **Cause**: The culprit seems to be `MultipleActions`. We would register it, but it wouldn't have a name, so it would appear as a nameless option.
   - **Fix**: if it has no name, don't register it. This is also future-proof in that any new nameless actions won't be automatically added.

Closes #10981
Part of #11353

issue_context.title: Actions with no name appear as nameless in SUI
issue_context.body:
### Windows Terminal version (or Windows build number)

1.11.2241.0

### Other Software

None

### Steps to reproduce

1. Add an action with no name to settings.json
```js
        {
            "command": { "action": "copy", "copyFormatting": "all" },
            "keys": "ctrl+alt+c",
            "name": ""
        },
```
2. Open Settings UI > Actions


### Expected Behavior

Action still has a name it falls back to.

### Actual Behavior

![action appears in SUI with no name](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11050425/129979200-9d86940d-dc24-45d0-bb2b-17d6a982fc16.png)
comments: I'm adding this to the 1.11 milestone for now. It'd be nice to have before the actions page moves to stable.

Chatted with @DHowett. Moving this into v2.0 milestone.

2 ideas for how to get around this issue:
1. empty name --> replace with generated name
2. add help text
   - empty name --> display `<empty>` (or something similar)
   - add italic help text under name (generated name)
   - example:
      - "custom config 1" would be displayed as...
         - custom config 1
         - _wt.exe new-tab --profile 0; new-pane --profile 1_

In favor of approach 2

:tada:This issue was addressed in #11427, which has now been successfully released as `Windows Terminal Preview v1.12.2922.0`.:tada:
